name: ForceIQ Peak BOB pack
formerly: The app was formerly called 'Notch' internally; this pack was formerly BOB-Motion-Notch-v1 (renamed 2026-10-18, assets byte-identical).
consumer: GOAT macOS SwiftUI/Metal app — ForceIQ Peak surface

masters.idle: work/frames/idle (72 master frames; v1.1 plays f15..45..16 ping-pong = 60f)
masters.attention: NEW — idle masters f35..59..36 ping-pong + gold rim bloom

lineage.masters_vs_v2.1_launcher_psnr_db: 38.2–41.1 (masters are the lossless sources of the v2.1 launcher mp4s; diff = H.264 loss)
lineage.method: crop 832x832 at (351,87) from 1536x1024 masters (sphere centre 767,503; rim r=364) -> Lanczos to target px; same composite as v2.1 (shell.png + coin face (PASTE_XY 619,358, 296px) + glass-overlay.png)

visual_lock.mark: gold BOB + gold ghost coin in smoked-glass sphere — unchanged

attention.meaning: an alert is waiting for Chris

typing.meaning: streaming a reply (optional on ForceIQ Peak)

error.meaning: REAL failures only (not cancel / empty result / retry in flight)
error.playback: one-shot, hold f61, idle when cleared

sleeping.meaning: asleep after 10 min of complete inactivity (rides the idle loop: the pack has no sleeping pose)

loop.method: order-only ping-pong of master idle f15..f45..f16 (bob turning points)

attention_design.summary: Idle mark with a soft brand-gold bloom breathing just outside the gold rim, raised-cosine 48f/2.0s, mark pixels inside rim bit-identical to idle.
attention_design.halo: screen-blend exp falloff from r=369 (decay 15px master), fades to 0 by r=414; level 0.08..0.55 of gold

legibility: coin-region unsharp mask (r0.8; 55% @64, 70% @48) — local contrast only
alpha_method: unpremultiply from black: alpha=max(maxRGB, opaque sphere disc r<=368 master px); colour=rgb/alpha; straight alpha

verification.note: PSNR 99 = identical. H.264/HEVC 4:2:0 chroma subsampling limits PSNR at tiny sizes.

gaps: Rive .riv not produced (no official scriptable authoring; unofficial generators unverified) — rive-kit/ provided
HEVC-alpha 48px not produced (libx265 alpha aborts at 48x48) — use ProRes + avconvert
HEVC-alpha files not verified in AVFoundation (Linux box); ProRes 4444 + Mac transcode is the safe path
v2.1 idle wrap pop FIXED in v1.1 (order-only re-time, TRON GO 10/18)

changelog.note: Initial ForceIQ Peak pack (formerly BOB-Motion-Notch-v1): six states x 48/64/96/128/192px; HEVC-alpha, ProRes 4444, PNG-alpha, H.264-black.

Idle re-timed for a seamless wrap: order-only ping-pong of the same lossless master frames f15..f45..f16 (coin bob turning points), 72f/3.0s -> 60f/2.5s. No pixel changes (600/600 frames identical to the v1 renders of the same master frames). Wrap step at 128px: 2.630 -> 0.039 (mean step 0.381). Changed: idle in every format/size, the 5 PNG zips (idle sequences), idle posters (f0 is now master f15), contact sheet (new title). Attention unchanged.
